QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] The Cry of Victory
QuestInfo.0: #p2101004# wants to talk to you again...
QuestInfo.1: Ariant's guard, Tigun, told you that there is some good news in Azwan. Go to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k by choosing #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror Portal#k.
QuestInfo.2: You found #p2181000#, a member of Cygnus Knights, waiting for you at the Obelisk.

0.0: Have you heard about the giant shadow that covered the desert? Turns out it was an Obelisk and it led to something nobody could have ever suspected... a huge underground metropolis! The lost city of Azwan!
0.1: The Cygnus Knights who investigated the area tell me there was some kind of disturbance going on, but it sounded like it was being handled. Aren't you curious to know what's going on?

yes.0: Head down to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k. I'm sure you know how to get there by now, don't you? Just select #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror#k. Make sure to tell me what happens!

1.0: Because of the bravery of the explorers who fought with us last time, Azwan is in much better standing. Enter the Obelisk and see for yourself.

npc.0: You can use the Dimensional Mirror to get into the Obelisk. Hurry up.
